purpose: Structured original-language rules specification for six current fixed-loadout Space Marine profiles plus definition-only ability samples from nineteen additional datasheets. Audit/design input only; this file is not loaded by the match runtime and does not certify army legality.

scope.profile_boundary: Runtime scope remains the six fixed profiles and admitted Leader/Support pairings. Additional definition-only datasheets contribute ability descriptions only; they do not add runtime profiles, costs, loadouts, roster legality or chapter variants. Optional wargear, other squad sizes, other attachment combinations, chapter sheets and full roster legality remain outside this definition pass.
scope.source_policy: OpenHammer /v1/11e is the fast bulk discovery and provisional profile/weapon/ability-name input. Use Wahapedia /wh40k11ed/ for readable e11 rule references as each implementation slice is selected. Check applicable current Games Workshop Codex, faction-pack, FAQ/errata and points sources before implementing or marking that slice supported. Do not block unrelated catalog or engine work on a full-faction audit; preserve unresolved conflicts as provisional/unsupported. Imported records are never playable by default.

interaction_resolutions.resolution: Strategic Acumen selects a Combat Doctrine, so it uses the shared once-per-battle selection allowance for that doctrine. A rule that only makes an already selected doctrine active for another unit, such as Demi-company Commander, does not make a second selection. Gladius Codex Discipline permits one additional selection of a doctrine, including a selection made through Strategic Acumen.

A rule applying to a unit or models in that unit applies to every model in the Attached unit while its source unit remains. A rule naming a specific model applies only to that model. Finest Hour therefore modifies only the Captain model's melee attacks; unit abilities such as Tactical Precision apply to attacks by the Attached unit while the Lieutenant source remains.

The current core text grants 1 Core CP to each player during each Command phase and has no general one-CP-per-battle-round gain cap in the consulted CP rules. Transhuman Strategist grants 1 CP at the start of the battle round when its Warlord is not destroyed. Teleport Homer reduces the 1 CP Rapid Ingress use by 1; the general CP-cost rule floors the resulting cost at 0 CP.

Tactical Mainstay removes the Battle-shock and Engagement restrictions on starting an Action, and starting that Action does not remove shooting eligibility. The current core FAQ says a unit with a rule allowing it to start an Action while Battle-shocked can continue that Action if it becomes Battle-shocked after starting it. Other independent restrictions still apply.

After a unit finishes all attacks each time it was selected to shoot or fight, make one Hazard roll per selected weapon with HAZARDOUS. A roll of 1-2 fails; each failure inflicts 1 mortal wound on the unit, or 3 if every model in the unit is a MONSTER or VEHICLE. Resolve multiple rolls for the unit simultaneously. Mortal wounds are allocated to the unit normally; they are not assigned to the model that used a hazardous weapon.

When a rule secures an objective, it remains under that player control even after their units leave range, until the opponent level of control exceeds theirs at the end of a phase. The core FAQ allows a unit to secure an objective it took control of at end of Movement in that same phase.

The Incursor Squad datasheet currently has Haywire Mine. The Pilum Strike Team Boarding Actions Rules Adaptation explicitly removes that ability in that format; this exception does not replace the general datasheet ability.

definitions.name: Combat Doctrines
definitions.eligibility: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that have the Combat Doctrines ability.
definitions.timing: Start of the controlling player's Command phase.

effects.assault: When selected to make an Advance move, the unit remains eligible to declare a charge.
effects.devastator: The unit's ranged attacks gain Assault.
effects.tactical: When selected to make a Fall Back move, the unit remains eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

definitions.duration: Until the start of the controlling player's next Command phase.
limits: Each doctrine can be selected once per battle unless another rule explicitly changes that limit.
A unit can have only one doctrine active at a time; a later doctrine replaces its earlier doctrine.
resolved_interactions: Strategic Acumen spends the shared doctrine selection allowance; Demi-company Commander only activates the selected doctrine for its unit; Gladius Codex Discipline grants one additional selection.

definitions.name: Tactical Mainstay
definitions.timing: When checking action eligibility and when this unit starts an Action.
definitions.eligibility: This unit is Engaged or Battle-shocked when the eligibility check occurs, or this unit starts an Action.
definitions.effect: Being Engaged or Battle-shocked does not by itself make this unit ineligible to start an Action. Starting an Action with this ability does not by itself make this unit ineligible to shoot.
definitions.duration: The permission to start the Action applies at each eligibility check. If this unit becomes Battle-shocked after starting an Action, the current core FAQ permits it to continue that Action. The started Action does not itself remove shooting eligibility.
resolved_interactions: The core FAQ confirms continuation of the Action when a unit with permission to start Actions while Battle-shocked becomes Battle-shocked after starting it.
interactions_to_validate: Action-specific completion and interruption rules
